notes.title: How configure game level and joystick
notes.content:
Hi.
I'd like to thank everyone who played the game.
In this post I'll show a tutorial to set up joystyck and game level (easy, normal or hard).

To access the config panel click on config icon right side of the tutorial question mark icon on the top of the screen.
Thanks

notes.title: 80s Volleyball available now!
notes.content:
Welcome to the 80s and this is 80s Volleyball, a game based on 80s 8bit volleyball games, 
choose from 32 80s teams, play 80s tournaments or play in Season mode where you'll start in 1977 
and try to qualify for the major tournaments by the year 1988.[previewyoutube=OvwCVBU_fy4;full][/previewyoutube]
